WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        toYear(fs.DateKey)                                                        AS yr,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount)                                                       AS total_sales,
        sum(fs.TotalCost)                                                         AS total_cost,
        (sum(fs.SalesAmount) - sum(fs.TotalCost)) / sum(fs.SalesAmount) * 100     AS gross_margin_pct
    FROM retail.FactSales fs
    JOIN retail.DimProduct p
        ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(fs.DateKey) IN (2007, 2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        yr
)
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    yr,
    round(gross_margin_pct, 4)                                                              AS gross_margin_pct,
    round(
        gross_margin_pct
        - lagInFrame(gross_margin_pct) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ProductCategoryName
            ORDER BY yr
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
          ),
        4
    )                                                                                        AS yoy_change_pp
FROM base
ORDER BY
    ProductCategoryName,
    yr
